newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Triple S Plastics raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Triple S Plastics raised.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Wednesday it raised Triple S Plastics Inc to aggressive buy from hold and raised earnings estimates.
- Analyst Mark Parr said in a report he raised his earnings estimate for the year ending in March to $0.45 from $0.20 versus $0.28 last year. He said he raised his 1998 estimate to $0.80 from $0.40.
- It was off 1/4 to 7-3/8 in late morning exchange trading.
- Parr said his 12- to 18-month price target was $11.
- The custom injection molder said last month it earned $0.15 in the second quarter versus $0.12 a year ago, beating Parr's estimate of $0.05, he said.
